name: answer-me-with-html
description: Answer me with HTML plugin marketplace

plugins.name: answer-me-with-html
plugins.description: Answer hard questions with a one-page HTML: the model writes a short Markdown draft; the bundled CLI handles templates, SVG auto-layout and an STE controlled-writing check.

plugins.name: answer-me-with-html-always
plugins.description: Optional always-on mode: reminds the agent every turn to attach a one-page HTML whenever it gives a conclusion, summary, plan or comparison. Requires answer-me-with-html.
